## Invitations

A total of 1435 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was 84, representing a rate of 5.9 per cent. This indicates that participation was limited in relation to the number of invitations distributed. The attendance result should be considered when planning future outreach activity and reviewing how invitations are presented to prospective attendees.

Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring. Seasonal variation may therefore be relevant when interpreting the result and scheduling subsequent activity. The figures provide a clear baseline for comparing future invitations with attendance outcomes and for identifying opportunities to improve engagement.

## Contact

SMS contact was recorded as 0. Reminders were also recorded as 0. No SMS messages or reminders were sent to invitees as part of this activity. Future contact arrangements may be reviewed alongside attendance patterns, particularly if additional support is needed to encourage participation.
